news.headline: Neuraxis (NRXS) grants CEO 199K instantly vesting stock units
news.summary: An 8-K disclosed that CEO Brian Carrico received 199,188 immediately vesting restricted stock units through a stock-option exchange effective July 24, 2026, and that on August 13 the compensation committee granted him a further 193,329 RSUs vesting in three equal annual installments, alongside awards to CFO Timothy Henrichs, Adrian Miranda and Thomas Carrico. Non-cash equity compensation that adds to the share count on top of ongoing ATM and preferred-dividend dilution.

news.headline: NeurAxis Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Driven by 116% Year-Over-Year Revenue Growth
news.summary: Q2 revenue rose 116% year-over-year to $1.93M with gross margin expanding 230 basis points to 85.9%, as the Category I CPT code for PENFS effective January 1, 2026 pushed more devices to full reimbursement price. Cash stood at $8.3M on June 30 after raising $2.5M in the quarter via the ATM facility and warrant redemptions, with lower operating cash outflows.

news.headline: Earnings Call Transcript: NeurAxis Falls on Q2 2026 EPS Miss Despite 116% Revenue Growth
news.summary: Shares fell after Q2 EPS of -$0.19 missed the -$0.16 consensus and operating expenses jumped 53% year-over-year to $3.8M. Management named its three priorities as expanding insurance coverage, improving execution in already-covered markets and building the Veterans Affairs channel, confirming more than 100 million covered lives today, a target above 200 million by end-2027, and a plan for 10 commission-only VA territory reps in the field by September 15, 2026.

news.headline: NeurAxis (NRXS): Q2 2026 Earnings Review
news.summary: Independent review highlighted average selling price up 28% year-over-year to $992, closing in on the $1,195 list-price ceiling, and prior-authorization approval rates rising to 31% year-to-date from 12% a year earlier. It flagged the mid-September VA sales-force buildout as the main Q4 volume catalyst and noted management is cautiously optimistic on a major new payer coverage win in H2 2026 or early 2027.

news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with New Policies
news.summary: New medical policies for PENFS added more than 500,000 covered lives, expanding access to IB-Stim for beneficiaries in the Mid-Atlantic region. The company said the Category I CPT code plus inclusion of PENFS in leading clinical guidelines is reinforcing the therapy's clinical and economic case with payers.

news.headline: NeurAxis Declares Q2 2026 Stock Dividend on Series B Preferred Stock
news.summary: The board declared the Q2 2026 stock dividend on the Series B Preferred, issuing roughly 80,463 common shares at a $2.38 calculation rate, payable July 29 to holders of record July 21. Routine non-cash preferred housekeeping that adds modest ongoing dilution rather than operational news.

catalysts.label: VA sales force fully staffed
catalysts.detail: Management committed on the Q2 call to having 10 commission-only (1099) Veterans Affairs territory representatives in the field by September 15, 2026, working the VA Federal Supply Schedule contract secured in December 2025, and aimed at turning the VA into a Q4 IB-Stim volume driver.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly report, expected around mid-November on the company's usual cadence (Q3 2025 came on November 11; 2026 reports landed May 12 and August 11). Key tests: whether triple-digit revenue growth holds, whether ASP keeps climbing toward the $1,195 list price, and how much of the 53% opex step-up flows through to the loss and the cash line.

catalysts.label: Major national payer coverage decision
catalysts.detail: Talks with two large commercial payers are progressing and management said it is cautiously optimistic about a coverage win in H2 2026 or early 2027; the CEO has described a single major payer add as a potential slingshot toward profitability.

catalysts.label: Covered lives above 200 million
catalysts.detail: Management reiterated on the Q2 call that it expects to exceed 200 million covered lives by the end of 2027, roughly doubling from the 100 million-plus reached today, which requires a steady drumbeat of payer-policy wins like the August Mid-Atlantic addition of 500,000 lives.

pulse: NeurAxis's August 11 Q2 print confirmed the CPT-code reimbursement thesis is working - revenue up 116% year-over-year to $1.93M, gross margin 85.9%, ASP up 28% to $992, prior-authorization approvals at 31% versus 12% a year ago, and $8.3M of cash after a $2.5M ATM and warrant raise - but the stock sold off because EPS of -$0.19 missed the -$0.16 consensus while operating expenses rose 53% to $3.8M on hiring in sales, marketing, clinical and policy. Since the print the only company-specific news through August 21 has been an 8-K covering large RSU grants to the CEO and other executives (part of a July stock-option-to-RSU exchange plus new August 13 director/officer awards), so the tape is trading on positioning rather than fresh operating information. The next real test is execution: the 10-rep VA sales force due by September 15, the two large commercial payers in negotiation, and whether growth can outrun continued ATM, preferred and equity-comp dilution and the still-standing going-concern qualification.
